entries.title: Psalms 47:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Clap your hand, all you peoples; shout to God with the voice of triumph.

entries.title: Psalms 47:2
segments: For the LORD Most High [is] awesome, a great king over all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 47:3
segments: He shall humble the peoples under us, and nations under our feet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:4
segments: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the majesty of Jacob whom He loved. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 47:5
segments: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

entries.title: Psalms 47:6
segments: Sing praise to God, sing praise; sing praise to our King, sing praise.

entries.title: Psalms 47:7
segments: For God [is] King of all the earth; sing praises with understanding.

entries.title: Psalms 47:8
segments: God reigns over the nations, God sits on the throne of His holiness.

entries.title: Psalms 47:9
segments: The rulers of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth [are] God's; He is lifted up on high.
